title: Frenmo
tagline: Request and send any tokens to frens gasless on Polygon and Optimism
description: A mobile payment app built on Lens, Polygon, Polygon ZKEVM and Optimism - where you can request your frens pay you for things like their share of lunch with any token and completely gasless using Biconomy Gasless Transactions SDK. Web3's version of Venmo to send and request money to friends.
how_its_made:
A mobile payment app built on Lens, Polygon, Polygon ZKEVM and Optimism.

You can search for profiles on lens to send to a human readable address. Send tokens on 3 sponsor chains (Polygon, Polygon ZKEVM and Optimism)

Transactions are made gasless with Biconomy's Gasless Transaction SDK.
